yelping.definition: Form of yelp (gerund participle present): To utter an abrupt, high-pitched noise.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yo.definition: Form of yo (alternative): The name of the letter Ё/ё in Cyrillic alphabets.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngest.definition: Form of young (superlative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

yup.definition: Form of yuppie (abbreviation clipping informal): A young upwardly mobile urban professional person with an affluent lifestyle.

zackly.definition: Form of exactly (alternative dialectal): Without approximation; precisely.

zephyr.definition: A light wind from the west.

zinnia.definition: Any of several brightly coloured flowering plants, of the genus Zinnia, native to tropical America; old maid.

zou.definition: An indigenous people living along the frontier of India and Burma.

zouave.definition: One of a body of soldiers in the French service, originally Kabyle, but now composed of Frenchmen who wear the Kabyle dress.

zous.definition: An indigenous people living along the frontier of India and Burma.
